assumptions: The matrix is a position-frequency matrix with the pseudocount and background the scan states.
limits: A matrix match is a sequence-level prediction, not evidence of binding in a cell.
The threshold is relative to this matrix's range, so it is not comparable between matrices.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The matrix hits on both strands with their scores; the Optimize panel lists them per motif and writes no sentence over them.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where does a transcription-factor matrix match this sequence, on either strand, at a threshold set as a fraction of that matrix's own score range?

description: Find every place a transcription-factor binding motif (a position-frequency matrix, such as a JASPAR matrix's counts) matches a DNA sequence, on both strands, at a threshold set per motif as a fraction of that matrix's own score range. It is the scan the optimizer's avoid-motif specification counts, so the sites it lists are the ones an optimisation with that motif would remove. Each site carries its log-odds score and where that score falls in the matrix's range. A match is a sequence resemblance to the matrix, not evidence of binding.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

motifs.description: the matrices, each {name, counts: {A, C, G, T} per position, relativeThreshold (0-1 of the matrix's score range) or threshold (absolute log-odds)}. Pseudocounts are JASPAR's sqrt(N) by default.

sequence.description: the DNA to scan - leave unset to use the open record.

name: scan_motif_sites

perMotif.description: the number of matches for each motif, by name

sites.description: every match, by position: motif name, start and end (0-based, end exclusive), strand, log-odds score and its fraction of the matrix's range
